brief: Goldman Sachs equity sales note covering Wednesday's tape and five single-name updates. US equities closed higher, SPX +46bps to 7666, NDX +23bps, RTY +113bps, with small caps leading because rates gave modest relief and momentum stabilized. Europe fell for a third session and EU autos lost 2% as the energy and rates squeeze hit consumer discretionary. Cross-asset the desk stays tactically neutral for 3m and modestly pro-risk for 12m, overweight equities, neutral bonds, commodities and cash, underweight credit, because rates volatility, seasonal weakness, US midterms and geopolitics could lift near-term volatility, which argues for staying invested and hedging selectively. It recommends the French Domestic basket as an election-noise hedge given 50% domestic sales versus 15% for the CAC 40. On oil, counting tankers crossing with AIS off, Persian Gulf exports are estimated at 15-16mb/d, two thirds of pre-war levels, against 10mb/d visible. Broadcom revenue was in line, AI semi revenue grew 221% to $16.7bn, FY4Q guidance sits just below the Street, and the target rises to $540. Auto1, PPC and Ferrari price targets rise. M&G's first half was broadly in line with a c.3% operating capital generation beat.
